column1: # Sites proposed for a base of The Collective: one line per system. Kept by the Fleet Admiral; Intel
# proposes (its guidebook, queue.log). game/fleet/empire.py reads this file and adds what the chart and the public
# list of stations say about each system; governance/empire.md shows the result.
# Final reviewed three-road plan (Suggi, 2026-11-17 22:30-23:45 UTC; rule F33, orders P3):
#   - East road: GSC-0044 inner outpost (built) -> Oakridge station (candidate, when we decide) -> outer outpost chosen by agents.
#   - North road (first): Atria inner outpost (chosen) -> Yildun choke-point station (chosen) -> outer outpost chosen by agents.
#   - South road (later): Felis inner outpost (chosen) -> south station & outer outpost chosen by agents when ready.
#   - Deep frontier later: two stations deep out by jump gates, one outpost each (8 outposts & 5 stations total), chosen autonomously by the agents from Intel's readings.
# status: candidate (proposed, not decided), chosen (decided), built, dropped. poi: a place id, or - for none.
